verdict.rationale: Zep's governance docs say ABAC policies attach to API keys and UserGroups. These policies limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach, and are explicitly positioned for least-privilege agent access. missing for 10: documented workflow for issuing or rotating scoped keys, detail on policy granularity and attribute options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach with ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups.
Use policies when you need least-privilege access to context for agents and Memory MCP users.
Attribute-based access control governs API keys and UserGroups.
